subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for multi-agent completion isolation?
rationale: The source and discussion show real remaining failures, but the solution boundary spans session ownership, subagent delivery guarantees, fallback-lane behavior, detached-work cleanup, and possible isolation semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep #43367 open, review PRs such as #86540 individually, and close the umbrella only when linked lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Isolation Design
options.body: Make #96975 the canonical product direction and explicitly map remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Select one canonical issue per root cause and close this umbrella only after every production-evidence thread is linked to an owner.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep #43367 open, review PRs such as #86540 individually, and close the umbrella only when linked lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is mostly product architecture, and steipete appears in recent auth/subagent-adjacent history plus the VISION guardrail context.
